Subject:
EXTENSIONOFSHUTDOWNOFPLANTOFHONDAATLASCARS(PAKISTAN)LIMITED
Dear Sir,
In accordance with Clause 5.6.1 (a) of PSX Regulations, Honda Atlas Cars (Pakistan) Limited ("Company")
hereby conveys the followingmaterial information:
In pursuance to our letter dated October 18, 2023, the Company has decided to further extend the
shutdown of its plant from November 01, 2023, to November 07, 2023. Any change in plan wili be updated
accordingly.
You may please inform the TRE Certificate holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Thanking you.
